# OrbitPi

> OrbitPi is a software product company. We develop DocAI for document OCR, Inventory for warehouse and stock management, Leads for sales enquiries and Assets for fixed asset management. Each product addresses a specific operational workflow and can be used on its own.

Company: OrbitPi Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Site: https://orbitpi.com/
Contact: hello@orbitpi.com

## Products

- [OrbitPi DocAI](https://orbitpi.com/products/ai-document-ocr/): AI document OCR
- [OrbitPi Inventory](https://orbitpi.com/products/warehouse-inventory-management/): Warehouse inventory management
- [OrbitPi Leads](https://orbitpi.com/products/lead-management-software/): Lead management
- [OrbitPi Assets](https://orbitpi.com/products/asset-management-software/): Asset management software
